How we proved it never halts

A base-3 odometer made of tape flaws

The tape looks like a zebra stripe, 0101…, with a few dozen flaws: spots where two neighbouring cells match (00 or 11). The head sweeps back and forth, flipping every cell it crosses. Flipping keeps matching neighbours matching, so the pattern of flaws changes only where the head runs into one. Read the right way, the flaws form a base-3 odometer: a chain of digits in the middle counts the head's trips, and a four-digit dial at the left end ticks each time the chain rolls over.

The key idea: the head's behaviour repeats every four cells, so what happens at a flaw depends only on its position counted in fours and on the order of the flaws, not on exact distances, as long as flaws are not crowded together. A million-cell gap acts like a short gap with the same remainder, so one finite computation covers every size.

Why that settles it: a round ends when the dial overflows; then the chain regroups and the right end moves on to the next of six phases. After six rounds the picture repeats with two more digits and its long flawless stretches roughly nine times longer. The missing instruction fires only if the head, moving right, pushes a flaw two cells along while another flaw sits right beside it. No piece of a round does that, and every round ends in the same family of tapes, so the run never stops.

In Rocq (busycoq), a verified simulator that treats gap lengths as symbols replays the first 2.6 trillion steps. It then checks every chain block, dial tick and right-end phase for all sizes, and that each round returns to the same family of tapes.

Overview

In one sentence

Multi-level counter on 00/11 defects between inert fossil blocks; a new fossil 3F+72 cells long each epoch.

Submitted mechanism Between two blank ends the tape is alternating except at defects (two equal neighbours). A sweep complements the cells it crosses, so the defect pattern changes only when the head meets a defect. Sweeps run through fixed 4-cycles of states, and at a defect the head passes, turns or wiggles depending only on the defect's position mod 4 against the head's phase. Halting needs two adjacent defects met in one particular phase. (submission/README.md, Mechanism)

Mechanism

What to check here: the pictures show the mechanism that the rule table describes.

How it works: 6 notes
  • The tape is alternating cells with isolated defects (00 or 11). Sweeps flip every pair. A leftward head turns at a 00 in D-phase (E reads 0) or at an 11 in E-phase (C reads 1). A rightward head turns only at a 00 in B-phase (C reads 0), so the phase decides pass or turn.
  • Level 1: the head bounces between the right edge and a wall W that moves 1 cell per hit (E-turn 00 at x -> 11 at x-1, C-turn 11 at x -> 00 at x-1; 554/555 single-turn trips to 3e6). W eats the active block X while the right block Y grows by about 1.7 cells per trip.
  • Deeper trips stop at the defects between fossil blocks, which cycle through 2 or 3 positions (e.g. 180 -> 179 -> 178 -> 180), and at the left end. This is a mixed-radix counter, and each overflow ends a phase. There are 3 phases per epoch: X grows, then Y grows, then W eats X and Y freezes into a fossil.
  • Epoch laws, exact on every epoch from blank to 2e10 steps: fossils F = 2736 -> 8280 -> 24912 -> 74808 cells (F' = 3F + 72); mid blocks X = 248 -> 752 -> 2264 -> 6800 (X' = 3X + 8). There are 3 left records per epoch (3 cells each), and each epoch takes 9.04x longer than the one before.
  • Fossil lengths are inert mod 4. Inserting 4j cells into any block (fossils or X) leaves the run unchanged except for those lengths (4/4 starts, to 3.5e9 steps, the new blocks are identical). Inserting 2 mod 4 cells changes the run (3/3; one ran off a 2^25-cell tape).
  • Halting needs C> 111 or A> 11, i.e. two adjacent defects in the wrong phase. The run has no halt to 2e10 steps, and neither sibling halts to 2e9.

note
Nearest proved neighbour: our kill #11 (Sk1C2, SBCv6 TM21 architecture). Its .v has one counter level: shift lemmas S1-S6, window lemmas T1-T14, digit lemmas Lb/Lf/Rb/Ro, the rules M_spec / Mdrop_spec / O_spec, and an abstract INV over one digit list. W4-3 matches only the bottom layer (sweep and turn lemmas). Its counter has unboundedly many levels: fossil defects with 2-3 states, the 3-phase epoch and the left-end counter, and #11 has no analogue of these. The closest open cases are #32/R4 (multi-level counter, parked).
Proof strategy & riskshow the formal proof will go · 3 risks to watch

Build an exact abstract model at the defect level: turn/pass/reset rules by phase, the wall trip, and fossils kept only mod 4. Check that it reproduces every trip to 1e9, then look for a recursive invariant over the fossil list (epoch = 3 counter overflows). Siblings 512/588 would then need only a new init.

  • ▲The phase rule is not derived yet: which defects turn, pass or reset depends on the head's phase. The left-end region (a small counter that grows 3 cells per phase) is not ruled.
  • ▲A proof needs a recursive multi-level invariant with no template (the same shape as #32/R4, parked). Expect several stages.
  • ▲Residues mod 4 matter: a block of the wrong residue changes the run (one perturbed start ran off the tape), so the invariant must pin every fossil residue.

What the package README says it reused and changed (submission/README.md line 20, Template and what changed), quoted:

The outer shape is verify/SBCv6.v, Module TM21: configurations over a digit-block list, one invariant, a closure lemma, multistep_nonhalt + progress_nonhalt_cond. The computed, proved-correct step is the idea of verify/Sk1like_TC_v1.v.

  • Changed: TM21's hand-composed window lemmas are replaced by the verified simulator. The digit list is a chain of eight-state blocks with an exit phase. The right region needs an executor with 4-cycle jumps, and one macro step is a whole record interval (81 x 3^K visits) with six invariant classes and u -> 9u per period.

The file is 2,584 lines. The accompanying write-up is the informal proof; its first table maps each section to lemma names.

132Definition cR_idx (q : Q) (b : Sym) : option nat :=
133 match q, b with
134 | B, S0 => Some 0 | C, S1 => Some 1 | A, S0 => Some 2 | B, S1 => Some 3
135 | _, _ => None
136 end.
137Definition cL_st (i : nat) : Q :=
138 match i mod 4 with 0 => D | 1 => D | 2 => E | _ => C end.
139Definition cL_bt (i : nat) : Sym :=
140 match i mod 4 with 0 => S1 | 1 => S0 | 2 => S1 | _ => S0 end.
141Definition cL_idx (q : Q) (b : Sym) : option nat :=
142 match q, b with
143 | D, S1 => Some 0 | D, S0 => Some 1 | E, S1 => Some 2 | C, S0 => Some 3
144 | _, _ => None
145 end.
147(* the last symbol of a run (c, n) *)
148Definition lastb (c : Sym) (n : lf) : Sym := if N.eqb (N.modulo (lc n) 2) 0 then sneg c else c.
150Inductive cfg := Rc (q : Q) (l r : sd) | Lc (q : Q) (l r : sd).
152Definition ev_cfg nu sg (c : cfg) : Q * tape :=
153 match c with
154 | Rc q l r => (ev_sd nu sg l) {{q}}> (ev_sd nu sg r)
155 | Lc q l r => (ev_sd nu sg l) <{{q}} (ev_sd nu sg r)
156 end.
158Definition single (c : cfg) : option cfg :=
159 match c with
160 | Rc q l r =>
161 match pop r with
162 | Some (s, r') =>
163 match tm (q, s) with
164 | Some (w, R, q') => Some (Rc q' (push w l) r')
165 | Some (w, L, q') => Some (Lc q' l (push w r'))
166 | None => None
167 end
168 | None => None
169 end
170 | Lc q l r =>
171 match pop l with
172 | Some (s, l') =>
173 match tm (q, s) with
174 | Some (w, R, q') => Some (Rc q' (push w l') r)
175 | Some (w, L, q') => Some (Lc q' l' (push w r))
176 | None => None
177 end
178 | None => None
179 end
180 end.
182Definition tag (o : option cfg) : option (cfg * bool) :=
183 match o with Some c => Some (c, true) | None => None end.
185Definition sstep (c : cfg) : option (cfg * bool) :=
186 match c with
187 | Rc q l ((b, n) :: rs, t) =>
188 if is_zero n then Some (Rc q l (rs, t), false) else
189 match cR_idx q b with
190 | Some i =>
191 if all4 (lv n) then
192 Some (Rc (cR_st (i + N.to_nat (N.modulo (lc n) 4))) (push_run (sneg (lastb b n)) n l) (rs, t), posb n)
193 else tag (single c)
194 | None => tag (single c)
195 end
196 | Lc q ((b, n) :: ls, t) r =>
197 if is_zero n then Some (Lc q (ls, t) r, false) else
198 match cL_idx q b with
199 | Some i =>
200 if all4 (lv n) then
201 Some (Lc (cL_st (i + N.to_nat (N.modulo (lc n) 4))) (ls, t) (push_run (sneg (lastb b n)) n r), posb n)
202 else tag (single c)
203 | None => tag (single c)
204 end
205 | _ => tag (single c)
206 end.
208(* run exactly p steps; the flag says whether at least one TM step was made *)
209Fixpoint runp (p : positive) (c : cfg) : option (cfg * bool) :=
210 match p with
211 | xH => sstep c
212 | xO p' =>
213 match runp p' c with
214 | Some (c1, b1) => match runp p' c1 with Some (c2, b2) => Some (c2, orb b1 b2) | None => None end
215 | None => None
216 end
217 | xI p' =>
218 match sstep c with
219 | Some (c0, b0) =>
220 match runp p' c0 with
221 | Some (c1, b1) => match runp p' c1 with Some (c2, b2) => Some (c2, orb b0 (orb b1 b2)) | None => None end
222 | None => None
223 end
224 | None => None
225 end
226 end.

560 | [] => []
561 | v :: vs' => match strip0 vs' with [] => if N.eqb v 0 then [] else [v] | w => v :: w end
562 end.
564Fixpoint listN_eqb (a b : list N) : bool :=

573Definition runs_eqb (a b : list run) : bool :=
574 (fix f (a b : list run) := match a, b with
575 | [], [] => true
576 | (x, n) :: a', (y, m) :: b' => andb (andb (seqb x y) (lf_eqb n m)) (f a' b')
577 | _, _ => false end) a b.
579Definition tl_eqb (a b : tl_) : bool :=
580 match a, b with T0, T0 => true | TV i, TV j => Nat.eqb i j | _, _ => false end.
582Definition sd_eqb (a b : sd) : bool := andb (runs_eqb (fst a) (fst b)) (tl_eqb (snd a) (snd b)).
584Definition q_eqb (a b : Q) : bool :=
585 match a, b with A, A | B, B | C, C | D, D | E, E | F, F => true | _, _ => false end.
587Definition cfg_eqb (a b : cfg) : bool :=

589 | Rc q l r, Rc q' l' r' => andb (q_eqb q q') (andb (sd_eqb l l') (sd_eqb r r'))
590 | Lc q l r, Lc q' l' r' => andb (q_eqb q q') (andb (sd_eqb l l') (sd_eqb r r'))
591 | _, _ => false
592 end.

636Lemma cfg_eqb_ev nu sg a b : cfg_eqb a b = true -> ev_cfg nu sg a = ev_cfg nu sg b.
637Proof.
638 destruct a as [q l r|q l r], b as [q' l' r'|q' l' r']; cbn [cfg_eqb]; intros H; try discriminate;
639 apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H]; apply andb_prop in H as [H2 H3];

644Definition rstep (tgt : cfg) (st : cfg * bool * bool) : cfg * bool * bool :=
645 let '(c, pr, dn) := st in
646 if dn then st else
647 match sstep c with
648 | Some (c', b) => (c', orb pr b, cfg_eqb c' tgt)
649 | None => st
650 end.
652(* reach fuel c tgt = true: c reaches tgt in at most fuel simulator steps, at least one machine step *)
653Definition reach (fuel : positive) (c tgt : cfg) : bool :=
654 let '(c', pr, dn) := Pos.iter (rstep tgt) (c, false, false) fuel in andb pr dn.
656Lemma reach_spec fuel c tgt : reach fuel c tgt = true ->
657 forall nu sg, ev_cfg nu sg c -->+ ev_cfg nu sg tgt.
658Proof.
659 intros H nu sg. unfold reach in H.
660 pose (Inv := fun st : cfg * bool * bool => let '(c', pr, dn) := st in
661 Rel pr (ev_cfg nu sg c) (ev_cfg nu sg c') /\ (dn = true -> cfg_eqb c' tgt = true)).
662 assert (HI : Inv (Pos.iter (rstep tgt) (c, false, false) fuel)).
663 { apply Pos.iter_invariant.
664 - intros [[c1 pr] dn] [HR Hd]. unfold rstep.
665 destruct dn; [split; assumption|].
666 destruct (sstep c1) as [[c2 b]|] eqn:Es; [|split; assumption].
667 split; [|intros E; exact E].
668 apply (Rel_trans _ _ _ _ _ HR (sstep_spec nu sg _ _ _ Es)).
669 - split; [apply evstep_refl | discriminate]. }
670 destruct (Pos.iter (rstep tgt) (c, false, false) fuel) as [[c' pr] dn].
671 destruct HI as [HR Hd]. apply andb_prop in H as [-> ->].
672 rewrite <-(cfg_eqb_ev nu sg _ _ (Hd eq_refl)). exact HR.
673Qed.
675Definition cn (n : N) : lf := LF n [].
677(* ===================================================================== *)
678(* Blocks of the chain. *)
679(* ===================================================================== *)
681Fixpoint mkruns (b : Sym) (ns : list lf) : list run :=
682 match ns with [] => [] | n :: ns' => (b, n) :: mkruns (lastb b n) ns' end.
684(* gap variables of an m = 3 block: t = 4 + 4 x0, s = 4 + 4 x1, a = 1 + 4 x2, lp = 2 + 4 x3 *)
685Definition vt c := LF c [4;0;0;0]%N.
686Definition vs c := LF c [0;4;0;0]%N.
687Definition va c := LF c [0;0;4;0]%N.
688Definition vl c := LF c [0;0;0;4]%N.
690Inductive lab := U0 | U1 | U2 | W0 | W1 | D0 | D1 | D2.
692Definition lens (s : lab) : list lf :=
693 match s with
694 | U0 => [cn 3; vt 4; vs 4; va 1; vl 2]
695 | U1 => [cn 3; vt 4; vs 4; va 2; vl 1]
696 | U2 => [cn 3; vt 4; vs 4; va 3; vl 0]
697 | W0 => [cn 3; vt 1; vs 6; va 4; vl 0]
698 | W1 => [cn 3; vt 2; vs 5; va 4; vl 0]
699 | D0 => [cn 3; vt 3; vs 4; va 4; vl 0]
700 | D1 => [cn 2; vt 4; vs 4; va 4; vl 0]
701 | D2 => [cn 1; vt 5; vs 4; va 4; vl 0]
702 end%N.
703Definition blk (s : lab) : list run := mkruns S0 (lens s).
705(* a full block after the head has passed it leftward (now on the right of the head) *)
706Definition rlens (s : lab) : list lf :=
707 match s with
708 | D0 => [vl 0; va 4; vs 4; vt 3; cn 3]
709 | _ => [vl 0; va 3; vs 4; vt 4; cn 3]
710 end%N.
711Definition rblk (s : lab) : list run := mkruns S0 (rlens s).
713(* block 1 (m = 1), concrete *)
714Inductive lab1 := P0 | P1 | PD0 | PD1 | PD2.
715Definition lens1 (s : lab1) : list lf :=
716 match s with
717 | P0 => [cn 3; cn 1; cn 3] | P1 => [cn 3; cn 2; cn 2] | PD0 => [cn 3; cn 3; cn 1]
718 | PD1 => [cn 2; cn 4; cn 1] | PD2 => [cn 1; cn 5; cn 1]
719 end%N.
720Definition blk1 (s : lab1) : list run := mkruns S0 (lens1 s).
721Definition rblk1 : list run := mkruns S1 [cn 1; cn 3; cn 3]%N.
723(* exit phase: true = c + 2 (state A at the cut), false = c (state B) *)
724Definition stp (p : bool) : Q := if p then A else B.
726Definition turn (s : lab) : option (lab * bool) :=
727 match s with
728 | U0 => Some (U1, true) | U1 => Some (U2, true) | W0 => Some (W1, true) | W1 => Some (D0, true)
729 | D1 => Some (D0, false) | D2 => Some (D1, false) | _ => None
730 end.
731Definition reset (s : lab) (p : bool) : option (lab * bool) :=
732 match s, p with
733 | U2, true => Some (U0, true) | U2, false => Some (W0, true) | D0, false => Some (D2, false)
734 | _, _ => None
735 end.
736Definition turn1 (s : lab1) : option (lab1 * bool) :=
737 match s with
738 | P0 => Some (P1, true) | P1 => Some (PD0, true) | PD1 => Some (PD0, false) | PD2 => Some (PD1, false)
739 | PD0 => None
740 end.
742Definition sg2 (L R : side) : nat -> side := fun k => match k with O => L | _ => R end.
744Lemma reach_LR fuel q q' l l' nu L R :
745 reach fuel (Lc q (l, TV 0) ([], TV 1)) (Rc q' (l', TV 0) ([], TV 1)) = true ->
746 ev_runs nu l L <{{q}} R -->+ ev_runs nu l' L {{q'}}> R.
747Proof. intros H. exact (reach_spec _ _ _ H nu (sg2 L R)). Qed.
749Lemma reach_LL fuel q q' l r' nu L R :
750 reach fuel (Lc q (l, TV 0) ([], TV 1)) (Lc q' ([], TV 0) (r', TV 1)) = true ->
751 ev_runs nu l L <{{q}} R -->+ L <{{q'}} ev_runs nu r' R.
752Proof. intros H. exact (reach_spec _ _ _ H nu (sg2 L R)). Qed.
754Lemma reach_RR fuel q q' r l' nu L R :
755 reach fuel (Rc q ([], TV 0) (r, TV 1)) (Rc q' (l', TV 0) ([], TV 1)) = true ->
756 L {{q}}> ev_runs nu r R -->+ ev_runs nu l' L {{q'}}> R.
757Proof. intros H. exact (reach_spec _ _ _ H nu (sg2 L R)). Qed.
759Lemma blk_turn s s' p nu L R : turn s = Some (s', p) ->
760 ev_runs nu (blk s) L <{{D}} R -->+ ev_runs nu (blk s') L {{stp p}}> R.
761Proof.
762 intros H. destruct s; cbn in H; inversion H; subst; clear H; cbn [stp];
763 apply (reach_LR 100); vm_compute; reflexivity.
764Qed.
766Lemma blk_pass s nu L R : turn s = None ->
767 ev_runs nu (blk s) L <{{D}} R -->+ L <{{D}} ev_runs nu (rblk s) R.
768Proof.
769 intros H. destruct s; cbn in H; inversion H; apply (reach_LL 100); vm_compute; reflexivity.
770Qed.
772Lemma blk_reset s p s' p' nu L R : reset s p = Some (s', p') ->
773 L {{stp p}}> ev_runs nu (rblk s) R -->+ ev_runs nu (blk s') L {{stp p'}}> R.
774Proof.
775 intros H. destruct s, p; cbn in H; inversion H; subst; clear H; cbn [stp];
776 apply (reach_RR 100); vm_compute; reflexivity.
777Qed.
779Lemma blk1_turn s s' p L R : turn1 s = Some (s', p) ->
780 ev_runs [] (blk1 s) L <{{D}} R -->+ ev_runs [] (blk1 s') L {{stp p}}> R.
781Proof.
782 intros H. destruct s; cbn in H; inversion H; subst; clear H; cbn [stp];
783 apply (reach_LR 100); vm_compute; reflexivity.
784Qed.
786Lemma blk1_pass L R : ev_runs [] (blk1 PD0) L <{{D}} R -->+ L <{{E}} ev_runs [] rblk1 R.
787Proof. refine (reach_LL 100 D E (blk1 PD0) rblk1 [] L R _). vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
789Lemma blk1_back L R : L {{B}}> ev_runs [] rblk1 R -->+ ev_runs [] (blk1 PD2) L {{B}}> R.
790Proof. refine (reach_RR 100 B B rblk1 (blk1 PD2) [] L R _). vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
792(* ===================================================================== *)
793(* The left word: a 4-digit ternary counter (episodes 0..79), and the *)
794(* left record (episode 80). *)
795(* ===================================================================== *)
797Definition dgr (v : nat) : list run :=
798 match v with
799 | O => [(S0, cn 1); (S0, cn 5)]
800 | S O => [(S0, cn 2); (S1, cn 4)]
801 | _ => [(S0, cn 3); (S0, cn 3)]
802 end%N.
804Definition lw (i : nat) : list run :=
805 if Nat.ltb i 81 then
806 [(S1, cn 3); (S1, cn 4)] ++ dgr (i mod 3) ++ dgr (i / 3 mod 3) ++ dgr (i / 9 mod 3) ++ dgr (i / 27 mod 3)
807 ++ [(S0, cn 2)]
808 else [(S0, cn 6); (S1, cn 4)] ++ dgr 0 ++ dgr 0 ++ dgr 0 ++ dgr 0 ++ [(S0, cn 2)].
810Definition LWs (i : nat) : side := ev_runs [] (lw i) (const S0).
812Lemma reach_T0 fuel q q' l l' (Y : side) :
813 reach fuel (Lc q (l, T0) ([], TV 0)) (Rc q' (l', T0) ([], TV 0)) = true ->
814 ev_runs [] l (const S0) <{{q}} Y -->+ ev_runs [] l' (const S0) {{q'}}> Y.
815Proof. intros H. exact (reach_spec _ _ _ H [] (fun _ => Y)). Qed.
817Definition lw_ok (i : nat) : bool := reach 1000 (Lc E (lw i, T0) ([], TV 0)) (Rc B (lw (S i), T0) ([], TV 0)).
819Lemma lw_all : forallb lw_ok (seq 0 81) = true.
820Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
822Lemma lw_ok_spec i Y : lw_ok i = true ->
823 ev_runs [] (lw i) (const S0) <{{E}} Y -->+ ev_runs [] (lw (S i)) (const S0) {{B}}> Y.
824Proof. exact (reach_T0 1000 E B (lw i) (lw (S i)) Y). Qed.
826Lemma lw_ok_lt i : i < 81 -> lw_ok i = true.
827Proof. intros Hi. pose proof lw_all as H. rewrite forallb_forall in H. apply H, in_seq. lia. Qed.
829Lemma lw_ep i Y : i < 81 -> LWs i <{{E}} Y -->+ LWs (S i) {{B}}> Y.
830Proof. intros Hi. apply lw_ok_spec, lw_ok_lt, Hi. Qed.
832(* ===================================================================== *)
833(* The chain: m = 3 blocks (nearest the head first), then block 1, then *)
834(* the left word. *)
835(* ===================================================================== *)
837Fixpoint chs (ls : list lab) (nus : list (list N)) (L : side) : side :=
838 match ls, nus with
839 | s :: ls', nu :: nus' => ev_runs nu (blk s) (chs ls' nus' L)
840 | _, _ => L
841 end.
843Fixpoint rchs (ls : list lab) (nus : list (list N)) (R : side) : side :=
844 match ls, nus with
845 | s :: ls', nu :: nus' => rchs ls' nus' (ev_runs nu (rblk s) R)
846 | _, _ => R
847 end.
849Fixpoint visit3 (ls : list lab) : option (list lab * bool) :=
850 match ls with
851 | [] => None
852 | s :: ls' =>
853 match turn s with
854 | Some (s', p) => Some (s' :: ls', p)
855 | None =>
856 match visit3 ls' with
857 | Some (ls'', p') => match reset s p' with Some (s'', p'') => Some (s'' :: ls'', p'') | None => None end
858 | None => None
859 end
860 end
861 end.
863Fixpoint cb (ls : list lab) (p : bool) : option (list lab * bool) :=
864 match ls with
865 | [] => Some ([], p)
866 | s :: ls' =>
867 match cb ls' p with
868 | Some (ls'', p') => match reset s p' with Some (s'', p'') => Some (s'' :: ls'', p'') | None => None end
869 | None => None
870 end
871 end.
873Definition fullb (s : lab) : bool := match turn s with None => true | Some _ => false end.
875Lemma visit3_spec ls : forall ls' p nus L R, visit3 ls = Some (ls', p) -> length ls = length nus ->
876 chs ls nus L <{{D}} R -->+ chs ls' nus L {{stp p}}> R.
877Proof.
878 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; intros ls' p nus L R H Hl; [discriminate|].
879 destruct nus as [|nu nus]; [discriminate|]. cbn in Hl. injection Hl as Hl.
880 cbn [visit3] in H.
881 destruct (turn s) as [[s1 p1]|] eqn:Et.
882 - inversion H; subst. cbn [chs]. apply blk_turn, Et.
883 - destruct (visit3 ls) as [[ls1 p1]|] eqn:Ev; [|discriminate].
884 destruct (reset s p1) as [[s2 p2]|] eqn:Er; [|discriminate].
885 inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [chs].
886 eapply progress_trans; [apply blk_pass, Et|].
887 eapply progress_trans; [apply (IH _ _ _ _ _ eq_refl Hl)|].
888 apply blk_reset, Er.
889Qed.
891Lemma pass_spec ls : forall nus L R, forallb fullb ls = true -> length ls = length nus ->
892 chs ls nus L <{{D}} R -->* L <{{D}} rchs ls nus R.
893Proof.
894 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; intros nus L R H Hl.
895 - destruct nus; [apply evstep_refl | discriminate].
896 - destruct nus as [|nu nus]; [discriminate|]. cbn in Hl. injection Hl as Hl.
897 cbn [forallb] in H. apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2].
898 cbn [chs rchs].
899 eapply evstep_trans; [apply progress_evstep, blk_pass|].
900 + unfold fullb in H1. destruct (turn s); [discriminate | reflexivity].
901 + apply IH; assumption.
902Qed.
904Lemma cb_spec ls : forall p ls' p' nus L R, cb ls p = Some (ls', p') -> length ls = length nus ->
905 L {{stp p}}> rchs ls nus R -->* chs ls' nus L {{stp p'}}> R.
906Proof.
907 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; intros p ls' p' nus L R H Hl.
908 - destruct nus; [|discriminate]. inversion H; subst. apply evstep_refl.
909 - destruct nus as [|nu nus]; [discriminate|]. cbn in Hl. injection Hl as Hl.
910 cbn [cb] in H.
911 destruct (cb ls p) as [[ls1 p1]|] eqn:Ec; [|discriminate].
912 destruct (reset s p1) as [[s2 p2]|] eqn:Er; [|discriminate].
913 inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [chs rchs].
914 eapply evstep_trans; [apply (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ Ec Hl)|].
915 apply progress_evstep, blk_reset, Er.
916Qed.
918Lemma visit3_len ls : forall ls' p, visit3 ls = Some (ls', p) -> length ls' = length ls.
919Proof.
920 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; intros ls' p H; [discriminate|]. cbn in H.
921 destruct (turn s) as [[s1 p1]|]; [inversion H; reflexivity|].
922 destruct (visit3 ls) as [[ls1 p1]|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
923 destruct (reset s p1) as [[s2 p2]|]; [|discriminate].
924 inversion H; subst. cbn. rewrite (IH _ _ eq_refl). reflexivity.
925Qed.
927Lemma cb_len ls : forall p ls' p', cb ls p = Some (ls', p') -> length ls' = length ls.
928Proof.
929 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; intros p ls' p' H; cbn in H; [inversion H; reflexivity|].
930 destruct (cb ls p) as [[ls1 p1]|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
931 destruct (reset s p1) as [[s2 p2]|]; [|discriminate].
932 inversion H; subst. cbn. rewrite (IH _ _ _ E). reflexivity.
933Qed.
935(* ===================================================================== *)
936(* One visit of the whole chain (Lemma C, C', and the left episodes). *)
937(* ===================================================================== *)
939Definition vst : Type := (list lab * lab1 * nat)%type.
941Definition lab1_eqb (a b : lab1) : bool :=
942 match a, b with P0, P0 | P1, P1 | PD0, PD0 | PD1, PD1 | PD2, PD2 => true | _, _ => false end.
944Definition vis (st : vst) : option (vst * bool) :=
945 let '(ls, b, i) := st in
946 match visit3 ls with
947 | Some (ls', p) => Some ((ls', b, i), p)
948 | None =>
949 if forallb fullb ls then
950 match turn1 b with
951 | Some (b', p1) => match cb ls p1 with Some (ls', p) => Some ((ls', b', i), p) | None => None end
952 | None =>
953 if andb (lab1_eqb b PD0) (Nat.ltb i 80) then
954 match cb ls false with Some (ls', p) => Some ((ls', PD2, S i), p) | None => None end
955 else None
956 end
957 else None
958 end.
960Definition b1s (b : lab1) (X : side) : side := ev_runs [] (blk1 b) X.
962Definition Gc (st : vst) (nus : list (list N)) (R : side) : Q * tape :=
963 let '(ls, b, i) := st in chs ls nus (b1s b (LWs i)) <{{D}} R.
964Definition Gx (st : vst) (nus : list (list N)) (p : bool) (R : side) : Q * tape :=
965 let '(ls, b, i) := st in chs ls nus (b1s b (LWs i)) {{stp p}}> R.
967Definition vlen (st : vst) : nat := let '(ls, _, _) := st in length ls.
969Lemma lab1_eqb_eq a b : lab1_eqb a b = true -> a = b.
970Proof. destruct a, b; cbn; congruence. Qed.
972Lemma vis_spec st st' p nus R : vis st = Some (st', p) -> vlen st = length nus ->
973 Gc st nus R -->+ Gx st' nus p R /\ vlen st' = vlen st.
974Proof.
975 destruct st as [[ls b] i]. cbn [vis vlen]. intros H Hl.
976 destruct (visit3 ls) as [[ls1 p1]|] eqn:Ev.
977 - inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [Gc Gx vlen]. split.
978 + apply visit3_spec; assumption.
979 + apply (visit3_len _ _ _ Ev).
980 - destruct (forallb fullb ls) eqn:Ef; [|discriminate].
981 destruct (turn1 b) as [[b1 p1]|] eqn:Et.
982 + destruct (cb ls p1) as [[ls1 p2]|] eqn:Ec; [|discriminate].
983 inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [Gc Gx vlen]. split; [|apply (cb_len _ _ _ _ Ec)].
984 eapply evstep_progress_trans; [apply pass_spec; assumption|].
985 unfold b1s at 1. eapply progress_evstep_trans; [apply blk1_turn, Et|].
986 apply cb_spec; assumption.
987 + destruct (andb (lab1_eqb b PD0) (Nat.ltb i 80)) eqn:Eb; [|discriminate].
988 apply andb_prop in Eb as [Eb Ei]. apply lab1_eqb_eq in Eb. subst b. apply Nat.ltb_lt in Ei.
989 destruct (cb ls false) as [[ls1 p2]|] eqn:Ec; [|discriminate].
990 inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [Gc Gx vlen]. split; [|apply (cb_len _ _ _ _ Ec)].
991 eapply evstep_progress_trans; [apply pass_spec; assumption|].
992 unfold b1s at 1. eapply progress_trans; [apply blk1_pass|].
993 eapply progress_trans; [apply lw_ep; lia|].
994 eapply progress_evstep_trans; [apply blk1_back|].
995 apply (cb_spec _ false); assumption.
996Qed.
998(* ===================================================================== *)
999(* Right-region episodes, abstractly. *)
1000(* ===================================================================== *)
1002Definition Ep (p : bool) (R R' : side) : Prop := forall l, l {{stp p}}> R -->* l <{{D}} R'.
1004Fixpoint EpSeq (ps : list bool) (R R' : side) : Prop :=
1005 match ps with
1006 | [] => R = R'
1007 | p :: ps' => exists R1, Ep p R R1 /\ EpSeq ps' R1 R'
1008 end.
1010Fixpoint runv (n : nat) (st : vst) : option (vst * list bool) :=
1011 match n with
1012 | O => Some (st, [])
1013 | S n' =>
1014 match vis st with
1015 | Some (st1, p) => match runv n' st1 with Some (st2, ps) => Some (st2, p :: ps) | None => None end
1016 | None => None
1017 end
1018 end.
1020Lemma runv_spec n : forall st st' ps nus R R', runv n st = Some (st', ps) -> vlen st = length nus ->
1021 EpSeq ps R R' -> Gc st nus R -->* Gc st' nus R'.
1022Proof.
1023 induction n as [|n IH]; intros st st' ps nus R R' H Hl HE.
1024 - cbn in H. inversion H; subst. cbn in HE. subst. apply evstep_refl.
1025 - cbn [runv] in H.
1026 destruct (vis st) as [[st1 p]|] eqn:Ev; [|discriminate].
1027 destruct (runv n st1) as [[st2 ps2]|] eqn:Er; [|discriminate].
1028 inversion H; subst; clear H.
1029 destruct HE as [R1 [HE1 HE2]].
1030 destruct (vis_spec _ _ _ nus R Ev Hl) as [H1 H2].
1031 eapply evstep_trans; [apply progress_evstep, H1|].
1032 eapply evstep_trans; [|apply (IH st1 st' ps2 nus R1 R' Er); [congruence | exact HE2]].
1033 destruct st1 as [[ls1 b1] i1]. cbn [Gx Gc]. apply HE1.
1034Qed.
1036(* ===================================================================== *)
1037(* Lemma T: the visits of one record interval, as a computation on block *)
1038(* labels. *)
1039(* ===================================================================== *)
1041Lemma runv_add a : forall b st st1 ps1 st2 ps2,
1042 runv a st = Some (st1, ps1) -> runv b st1 = Some (st2, ps2) -> runv (a + b) st = Some (st2, ps1 ++ ps2).
1043Proof.
1044 induction a as [|a IH]; intros b st st1 ps1 st2 ps2 H1 H2.
1045 - cbn in H1. inversion H1; subst. exact H2.
1046 - change (S a + b) with (S (a + b)). cbn [runv] in H1 |- *. destruct (vis st) as [[st0 p]|]; [|discriminate].
1047 destruct (runv a st0) as [[st3 ps3]|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
1048 inversion H1; subst. rewrite (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ E H2). reflexivity.
1049Qed.
1051Lemma runv_one st st' p : vis st = Some (st', p) -> runv 1 st = Some (st', [p]).
1052Proof. intros H. cbn. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.
1054Lemma vis3 ls ls' p b i : visit3 ls = Some (ls', p) -> vis (ls, b, i) = Some ((ls', b, i), p).
1055Proof. intros H. cbn. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.
1057Lemma repeat_add {X} (x : X) n m : repeat x (n + m) = repeat x n ++ repeat x m.
1058Proof. induction n; cbn in *; congruence. Qed.
1060Lemma repeat_snoc {X} (x : X) n l : repeat x n ++ x :: l = repeat x (S n) ++ l.
1061Proof. induction n; cbn in *; congruence. Qed.
1063Lemma pow3_pos j : 1 <= 3 ^ j.
1064Proof. induction j; cbn; lia. Qed.
1066Lemma visit3_U2 j X X' : visit3 X = Some (X', true) -> visit3 (repeat U2 j ++ X) = Some (repeat U0 j ++ X', true).
1067Proof. intros H. induction j as [|j IH]; cbn; [exact H|]. rewrite IH. reflexivity. Qed.
1069Lemma cb_U2 j X p X' : cb X p = Some (X', true) -> cb (repeat U2 j ++ X) p = Some (repeat U0 j ++ X', true).
1070Proof. intros H. induction j as [|j IH]; cbn; [exact H|]. rewrite IH. reflexivity. Qed.
1072Lemma visit3_full ls : forallb fullb ls = true -> visit3 ls = None.
1073Proof.
1074 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; cbn; intros H; [reflexivity|].
1075 apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2]. unfold fullb in H1.
1076 destruct (turn s); [discriminate|]. rewrite IH by exact H2. reflexivity.
1077Qed.
1079Lemma fullb_U2 j : forallb fullb (repeat U2 j) = true.
1080Proof. induction j; cbn; auto. Qed.
1082Lemma fullb_D0 j : forallb fullb (repeat D0 j) = true.
1083Proof. induction j; cbn; auto. Qed.
1085Lemma fullb_app a b : forallb fullb a = true -> forallb fullb b = true -> forallb fullb (a ++ b) = true.
1086Proof. intros. rewrite forallb_app. apply andb_true_intro. auto. Qed.
1088Lemma rep_app {X} (x : X) a b : repeat x a ++ repeat x b = repeat x (a + b).
1089Proof. symmetry. apply repeat_add. Qed.
1091(* CU: the j blocks nearest the head count from all U0 to all U2 *)
1092Lemma CU j : forall rest b i,
1093 runv (3 ^ j - 1) (repeat U0 j ++ rest, b, i) = Some ((repeat U2 j ++ rest, b, i), repeat true (3 ^ j - 1)).
1094Proof.
1095 induction j as [|j IH]; intros rest b i; [reflexivity|].
1096 pose proof (pow3_pos j) as Hp.
1097 rewrite <-(repeat_snoc U0 j rest), <-(repeat_snoc U2 j rest).
1098 pose proof (IH (U0 :: rest) b i) as H1.
1099 assert (H2 : runv 1 (repeat U2 j ++ U0 :: rest, b, i) = Some ((repeat U0 j ++ U1 :: rest, b, i), repeat true 1))
1100 by (apply runv_one, vis3, visit3_U2; reflexivity).
1101 pose proof (IH (U1 :: rest) b i) as H3.
1102 assert (H4 : runv 1 (repeat U2 j ++ U1 :: rest, b, i) = Some ((repeat U0 j ++ U2 :: rest, b, i), repeat true 1))
1103 by (apply runv_one, vis3, visit3_U2; reflexivity).
1104 pose proof (IH (U2 :: rest) b i) as H5.
1105 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H4 H5) as H45.
1106 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H3 H45) as H35.
1107 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 H35) as H25.
1108 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H25) as H.
1109 rewrite !rep_app in H.
1110 replace (3 ^ S j - 1) with ((3 ^ j - 1) + (1 + ((3 ^ j - 1) + (1 + (3 ^ j - 1))))) by (cbn; lia).
1111 exact H.
1112Qed.
1114(* CW: a suffix W0 U0^j counts to D0 U2^j *)
1115Lemma CW j : forall rest b i,
1116 runv (3 ^ S j - 1) (repeat U0 j ++ W0 :: rest, b, i) =
1117 Some ((repeat U2 j ++ D0 :: rest, b, i), repeat true (3 ^ S j - 1)).
1118Proof.
1119 intros rest b i. pose proof (pow3_pos j) as Hp.
1120 pose proof (CU j (W0 :: rest) b i) as H1.
1121 assert (H2 : runv 1 (repeat U2 j ++ W0 :: rest, b, i) = Some ((repeat U0 j ++ W1 :: rest, b, i), repeat true 1))
1122 by (apply runv_one, vis3, visit3_U2; reflexivity).
1123 pose proof (CU j (W1 :: rest) b i) as H3.
1124 assert (H4 : runv 1 (repeat U2 j ++ W1 :: rest, b, i) = Some ((repeat U0 j ++ D0 :: rest, b, i), repeat true 1))
1125 by (apply runv_one, vis3, visit3_U2; reflexivity).
1126 pose proof (CU j (D0 :: rest) b i) as H5.
1127 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H4 H5) as H45.
1128 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H3 H45) as H35.
1129 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 H35) as H25.
1130 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H25) as H.
1131 rewrite !rep_app in H.
1132 replace (3 ^ S j - 1) with ((3 ^ j - 1) + (1 + ((3 ^ j - 1) + (1 + (3 ^ j - 1))))) by (cbn; lia).
1133 exact H.
1134Qed.
1136Fixpoint tc (j : nat) : nat :=
1137 match j with
1138 | O => 0
1139 | S O => 2
1140 | S j' => 3 ^ j + tc j'
1141 end.
1143Lemma tc_closed j : 2 * tc (S j) + 5 = 3 ^ S (S j).
1144Proof.
1145 induction j as [|j IH]; [reflexivity|].
1146 change (tc (S (S j))) with (3 ^ S (S j) + tc (S j)). cbn [Nat.pow] in *. lia.
1147Qed.
1149(* S3: from U0^j W0 d (d a D block that is not full) to all D *)
1150Lemma S3 j : forall d d' rest b i, turn d = Some (d', false) ->
1151 runv (tc (S j) + 1) (repeat U0 j ++ W0 :: d :: rest, b, i) =
1152 Some ((D2 :: repeat D1 j ++ d' :: rest, b, i), repeat true (tc (S j)) ++ [false]).
1153Proof.
1154 induction j as [|j IH]; intros d d' rest b i Hd.
1155 - pose proof (CW 0 (d :: rest) b i) as H1.
1156 assert (H2 : runv 1 (repeat U2 0 ++ D0 :: d :: rest, b, i) = Some ((D2 :: d' :: rest, b, i), [false]))
1157 by (apply runv_one, vis3; cbn; rewrite Hd; reflexivity).
1158 exact (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H2).
1159 - pose proof (pow3_pos (S (S j))) as Hp.
1160 pose proof (CW (S j) (d :: rest) b i) as H1.
1161 assert (H2 : runv 1 (repeat U2 (S j) ++ D0 :: d :: rest, b, i) =
1162 Some ((repeat U0 j ++ W0 :: D2 :: d' :: rest, b, i), repeat true 1)).
1163 { apply runv_one, vis3. rewrite <-repeat_snoc. apply visit3_U2. cbn. rewrite Hd. reflexivity. }
1164 pose proof (IH D2 D1 (d' :: rest) b i eq_refl) as H3.
1165 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 H3) as H23.
1166 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H23) as H.
1167 rewrite repeat_snoc, app_assoc, rep_app, app_assoc, rep_app in H.
1168 change (tc (S (S j))) with (3 ^ S (S j) + tc (S j)).
1169 replace (3 ^ S (S j) + tc (S j) + 1) with ((3 ^ S (S j) - 1) + (1 + (tc (S j) + 1))) by lia.
1170 replace (3 ^ S (S j) + tc (S j)) with (3 ^ S (S j) - 1 + 1 + tc (S j)) by lia.
1171 exact H.
1172Qed.
1174(* ---- all-D words count like a plain ternary counter, every exit at phase c ---- *)
1176Definition isD (s : lab) : bool := match s with D0 | D1 | D2 => true | _ => false end.
1177Definition dv (s : lab) : nat := match s with D1 => 1 | D0 => 2 | _ => 0 end.
1178Fixpoint dval (ls : list lab) : nat := match ls with [] => 0 | s :: ls' => dv s + 3 * dval ls' end.
1179Definition dv1 (b : lab1) : nat := match b with PD1 => 1 | PD0 => 2 | _ => 0 end.
1180Definition isD1 (b : lab1) : bool := match b with PD0 | PD1 | PD2 => true | _ => false end.
1182Lemma dval_lt ls : forallb isD ls = true -> dval ls < 3 ^ length ls.
1183Proof.
1184 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; cbn; intros H; [lia|].
1185 apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2]. specialize (IH H2). destruct s; cbn in *; try discriminate; lia.
1186Qed.
1188Lemma dval_max ls : forallb isD ls = true -> dval ls + 1 = 3 ^ length ls -> ls = repeat D0 (length ls).
1189Proof.
1190 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; cbn; intros H E; [reflexivity|].
1191 apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2]. pose proof (dval_lt ls H2).
1192 destruct s; cbn in *; try discriminate; try lia. f_equal. apply IH; [exact H2 | lia].
1193Qed.
1195Lemma visit3_D ls : forallb isD ls = true -> dval ls + 1 < 3 ^ length ls ->
1196 exists ls', visit3 ls = Some (ls', false) /\ forallb isD ls' = true /\ dval ls' = dval ls + 1 /\
1197 length ls' = length ls.
1198Proof.
1199 induction ls as [|s ls IH]; cbn; intros H E; [lia|].
1200 apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2]. pose proof (dval_lt ls H2).
1201 destruct s; cbn in H1; try discriminate.
1202 - assert (E' : dval ls + 1 < 3 ^ length ls) by (cbn in E; lia).
1203 destruct (IH H2 E') as [ls' [E1 [E2 [E3 E4]]]]. cbn. rewrite E1. cbn.
1204 exists (D2 :: ls'). cbn. rewrite E2, E3, E4. repeat split; lia.
1205 - exists (D0 :: ls). cbn. rewrite H2. repeat split; lia.
1206 - exists (D1 :: ls). cbn. rewrite H2. repeat split; lia.
1207Qed.
1209Lemma cb_D0 j : cb (repeat D0 j) false = Some (repeat D2 j, false).
1210Proof. induction j as [|j IH]; cbn; [reflexivity|]. rewrite IH. reflexivity. Qed.
1212Lemma isD_D2 j : forallb isD (repeat D2 j) = true.
1213Proof. induction j; cbn; auto. Qed.
1215Lemma dval_D2 j : dval (repeat D2 j) = 0.
1216Proof. induction j; cbn; lia. Qed.
1218Lemma dval_D1 j : 2 * dval (repeat D1 j) + 1 = 3 ^ j.
1219Proof. induction j; cbn in *; lia. Qed.
1221Lemma isD_D1 j : forallb isD (repeat D1 j) = true.
1222Proof. induction j; cbn; auto. Qed.
1224Lemma vis_b1 ls b b' p1 ls' p i : forallb fullb ls = true -> turn1 b = Some (b', p1) -> cb ls p1 = Some (ls', p) ->
1225 vis (ls, b, i) = Some ((ls', b', i), p).
1226Proof. intros H1 H2 H3. cbn. rewrite (visit3_full _ H1), H1, H2, H3. reflexivity. Qed.
1228Lemma vis_co ls ls' p i : forallb fullb ls = true -> i < 80 -> cb ls false = Some (ls', p) ->
1229 vis (ls, PD0, i) = Some ((ls', PD2, S i), p).
1230Proof.
1231 intros H1 H2 H3. cbv beta iota zeta delta [vis]. rewrite (visit3_full _ H1), H1. apply Nat.ltb_lt in H2.
1232 cbv beta iota delta [turn1 lab1_eqb andb]. rewrite H2, H3. reflexivity.
1233Qed.
1235Lemma allD n : forall ls b i, forallb isD ls = true -> isD1 b = true ->
1236 dval ls + 3 ^ length ls * dv1 b + n + 1 = 3 ^ S (length ls) ->
1237 runv n (ls, b, i) = Some ((repeat D0 (length ls), PD0, i), repeat false n).
1238Proof.
1239 induction n as [|n IH]; intros ls b i H1 H2 E; pose proof (dval_lt ls H1) as Hl; cbn [Nat.pow] in E.
1240 - assert (Eb : b = PD0) by (destruct b; cbn in *; try discriminate; try reflexivity; lia).
1241 subst b. cbn [dv1] in E. rewrite <-(dval_max ls H1) by lia. reflexivity.
1242 - destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases (dval ls + 1) (3 ^ length ls)) as [Hlt|Hge].
1243 + destruct (visit3_D ls H1 Hlt) as [ls' [E1 [E2 [E3 E4]]]].
1244 cbn [runv]. rewrite (vis3 _ _ _ b i E1).
1245 rewrite (IH ls' b i E2 H2) by (rewrite E3, E4; cbn [Nat.pow]; lia). rewrite E4. reflexivity.
1246 + assert (Hd : dval ls + 1 = 3 ^ length ls) by lia.
1247 pose proof (dval_max ls H1 Hd) as Hr. remember (length ls) as m eqn:Em. subst ls.
1248 destruct b; cbn in H2; try discriminate; cbn [dv1] in E; [lia| |].
1249 * cbn [runv]. rewrite (vis_b1 _ PD1 PD0 false _ _ i (fullb_D0 m) eq_refl (cb_D0 m)).
1250 rewrite (IH (repeat D2 m) PD0 i (isD_D2 m) eq_refl) by (rewrite dval_D2, repeat_length; cbn; lia).
1251 rewrite repeat_length. reflexivity.
1252 * cbn [runv]. rewrite (vis_b1 _ PD2 PD1 false _ _ i (fullb_D0 m) eq_refl (cb_D0 m)).
1253 rewrite (IH (repeat D2 m) PD1 i (isD_D2 m) eq_refl) by (rewrite dval_D2, repeat_length; cbn; lia).
1254 rewrite repeat_length. reflexivity.
1255Qed.
1257Lemma cyc m i : i < 80 ->
1258 runv (3 ^ S m) (repeat D0 m, PD0, i) = Some ((repeat D0 m, PD0, S i), repeat false (3 ^ S m)).
1259Proof.
1260 intros Hi. pose proof (pow3_pos (S m)) as Hp.
1261 replace (3 ^ S m) with (1 + (3 ^ S m - 1)) by lia. rewrite repeat_add.
1262 eapply runv_add; [apply runv_one, (vis_co _ _ _ _ (fullb_D0 m) Hi (cb_D0 m))|].
1263 pose proof (allD (3 ^ S m - 1) (repeat D2 m) PD2 (S i) (isD_D2 m) eq_refl) as A.
1264 rewrite dval_D2, repeat_length in A. apply A. cbn [dv1]. lia.
1265Qed.
1267Lemma cycs c : forall m i, i + c <= 80 ->
1268 runv (c * 3 ^ S m) (repeat D0 m, PD0, i) = Some ((repeat D0 m, PD0, i + c), repeat false (c * 3 ^ S m)).
1269Proof.
1270 induction c as [|c IH]; intros m i Hi; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r; reflexivity|].
1271 change (S c * 3 ^ S m) with (3 ^ S m + c * 3 ^ S m).
1272 rewrite repeat_add. eapply runv_add; [apply cyc; lia|].
1273 replace (i + S c) with (S i + c) by lia. apply IH. lia.
1274Qed.
1276Lemma rep_app_cons {X} (x : X) a b l : repeat x a ++ (repeat x b ++ l) = repeat x (a + b) ++ l.
1277Proof. rewrite app_assoc, rep_app. reflexivity. Qed.
1279Lemma odd_pow3 j : exists k, 3 ^ j = 2 * k + 1.
1280Proof. induction j as [|j [k Hk]]; [exists 0; reflexivity|]. exists (3 * k + 1). cbn [Nat.pow]. lia. Qed.
1282Lemma half9 j : 2 * ((9 * 3 ^ j + 1) / 2) = 9 * 3 ^ j + 1.
1283Proof.
1284 destruct (odd_pow3 j) as [k Hk]. rewrite Hk.
1285 replace (9 * (2 * k + 1) + 1) with ((9 * k + 5) * 2) by lia. rewrite Nat.div_mul by lia. lia.
1286Qed.
1288(* Lemma T: one whole interval of visits, m = K - 1 blocks with m = 3 *)
1289Lemma interval m : 2 <= m ->
1290 exists T, 2 * T + 5 = 3 ^ S (S m) /\
1291 runv (81 * 3 ^ S m - 1) (repeat U0 m, P0, 0) =
1292 Some ((repeat D0 m, PD0, 80), repeat true T ++ repeat false (81 * 3 ^ S m - 1 - T)).
1293Proof.
1294 intros Hm. destruct m as [|[|m]]; [lia|lia|].
1295 pose proof (half9 (S m)) as Hh.
1296 set (y := 3 ^ S m) in *.
1297 assert (Hy : 1 <= y) by apply pow3_pos.
1298 assert (E3 : 3 ^ S (S m) = 3 * y) by reflexivity.
1299 assert (E9 : 3 ^ S (S (S m)) = 9 * y) by (cbn [Nat.pow]; unfold y; cbn [Nat.pow]; lia).
1300 pose proof (tc_closed m) as Etc. rewrite E3 in Etc.
1301 (* phase 1: block 1 plays the role of W *)
1302 assert (H1 : runv (3 ^ S (S (S m)) - 1) (repeat U0 (S (S m)), P0, 0) =
1303 Some ((repeat U2 (S (S m)), PD0, 0), repeat true (3 ^ S (S (S m)) - 1))).
1304 { pose proof (CU (S (S m)) [] P0 0) as A1. rewrite !app_nil_r in A1.
1305 assert (A2 : runv 1 (repeat U2 (S (S m)), P0, 0) = Some ((repeat U0 (S (S m)), P1, 0), repeat true 1)).
1306 { apply runv_one, (vis_b1 _ _ _ true); [apply fullb_U2 | reflexivity |].
1307 pose proof (cb_U2 (S (S m)) [] true [] eq_refl) as C. rewrite !app_nil_r in C. exact C. }
1308 pose proof (CU (S (S m)) [] P1 0) as A3. rewrite !app_nil_r in A3.
1309 assert (A4 : runv 1 (repeat U2 (S (S m)), P1, 0) = Some ((repeat U0 (S (S m)), PD0, 0), repeat true 1)).
1310 { apply runv_one, (vis_b1 _ _ _ true); [apply fullb_U2 | reflexivity |].
1311 pose proof (cb_U2 (S (S m)) [] true [] eq_refl) as C. rewrite !app_nil_r in C. exact C. }
1312 pose proof (CU (S (S m)) [] PD0 0) as A5. rewrite !app_nil_r in A5.
1313 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ A4 A5) as A45.
1314 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ A3 A45) as A35.
1315 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ A2 A35) as A25.
1316 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ A1 A25) as A.
1317 rewrite !rep_app in A. rewrite E3 in A. rewrite E9.
1318 replace (9 * y - 1) with (3 * y - 1 + (1 + (3 * y - 1 + (1 + (3 * y - 1))))) by lia. exact A. }
1319 (* carry-out 1 *)
1320 assert (H2 : runv 1 (repeat U2 (S (S m)), PD0, 0) = Some ((repeat U0 (S m) ++ [W0], PD2, 1), repeat true 1)).
1321 { apply runv_one, vis_co; [apply fullb_U2 | lia |].
1322 rewrite <-(app_nil_r (repeat U2 (S (S m)))), <-(repeat_snoc U2 (S m) []). apply cb_U2. reflexivity. }
1323 (* W-suffix of length S (S m) then the turn of block 1 *)
1324 pose proof (CW (S m) [] PD2 1) as H3.
1325 assert (H4 : runv 1 (repeat U2 (S m) ++ [D0], PD2, 1) = Some ((repeat U0 m ++ [W0; D2], PD1, 1), repeat true 1)).
1326 { apply runv_one, (vis_b1 _ _ _ false).
1327 - apply fullb_app; [apply fullb_U2 | reflexivity].
1328 - reflexivity.
1329 - rewrite <-(repeat_snoc U2 m [D0]). apply cb_U2. reflexivity. }
1330 pose proof (S3 m D2 D1 [] PD1 1 eq_refl) as H5.
1331 rewrite repeat_snoc, app_nil_r in H5.
1332 (* all-D counting up to the second carry-out *)
1333 assert (H6 : runv ((9 * y + 1) / 2) (D2 :: repeat D1 (S m), PD1, 1) =
1334 Some ((repeat D0 (S (S m)), PD0, 1), repeat false ((9 * y + 1) / 2))).
1335 { pose proof (dval_D1 (S m)) as Ed. fold y in Ed.
1336 pose proof (allD ((9 * y + 1) / 2) (D2 :: repeat D1 (S m)) PD1 1 ltac:(cbn; apply isD_D1) eq_refl) as A.
1337 cbn [length dval dv dv1] in A. rewrite repeat_length in A. apply A.
1338 rewrite E3, E9. lia. }
1339 (* 79 more carry-outs in the all-D regime *)
1340 pose proof (cycs 79 (S (S m)) 1 ltac:(lia)) as H7. rewrite E9 in H7.
1341 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H6 H7) as H67.
1342 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H5 H67) as H57.
1343 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H4 H57) as H47.
1344 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H3 H47) as H37.
1345 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 H37) as H27.
1346 pose proof (runv_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H27) as H.
1347 rewrite rep_app, <-app_assoc in H. change [false] with (repeat false 1) in H.
1348 rewrite rep_app, !rep_app_cons in H. rewrite E3, E9 in H.
1349 assert (E27 : 3 ^ S (S (S (S m))) = 27 * y) by (unfold y; cbn [Nat.pow]; lia).
1350 exists (9 * y - 1 + 1 + (3 * y - 1) + 1 + tc (S m)). split; [rewrite E27; lia|].
1351 rewrite E9.
1352 replace (81 * (9 * y) - 1)
1353 with (9 * y - 1 + (1 + (3 * y - 1 + (1 + (tc (S m) + 1 + ((9 * y + 1) / 2 + 79 * (9 * y)))))))
1354 by lia.
1355 rewrite H.
1356 replace (9 * y - 1 + (1 + (3 * y - 1 + (1 + (tc (S m) + 1 + ((9 * y + 1) / 2 + 79 * (9 * y))))))
1357 - (9 * y - 1 + 1 + (3 * y - 1) + 1 + tc (S m)))
1358 with (1 + ((9 * y + 1) / 2 + 79 * (9 * y))) by lia.
1359 reflexivity.
1360Qed.
1362(* the chain side of one interval, on the machine *)
1363Lemma interval_tm m nus R R' : 2 <= m -> length nus = m ->
1364 (forall T, 2 * T + 5 = 3 ^ S (S m) -> EpSeq (repeat true T ++ repeat false (81 * 3 ^ S m - 1 - T)) R R') ->
1365 Gc (repeat U0 m, P0, 0) nus R -->* Gc (repeat D0 m, PD0, 80) nus R'.
1366Proof.
1367 intros Hm Hl HE. destruct (interval m Hm) as [T [ET Hr]].
1368 apply (runv_spec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr); [cbn; rewrite repeat_length; auto | apply HE, ET].
1369Qed.
1371(* the record visit: carry-out at all D0, left episode 80 (the left record), carry back to all D2 *)
1372Lemma record_visit m nus R : length nus = m ->
1373 Gc (repeat D0 m, PD0, 80) nus R -->+ chs (repeat D2 m) nus (b1s PD2 (LWs 81)) {{B}}> R.
1374Proof.
1375 intros Hl. cbn [Gc].
1376 eapply evstep_progress_trans; [apply pass_spec; [apply fullb_D0 | rewrite repeat_length; auto]|].
1377 unfold b1s. eapply progress_trans; [apply blk1_pass|].
1378 eapply progress_trans; [apply lw_ep; lia|].
1379 eapply progress_evstep_trans; [apply blk1_back|].
1380 apply (cb_spec _ false _ false); [apply cb_D0 | rewrite repeat_length; auto].
1381Qed.
1383(* ===================================================================== *)
1384(* The right region: a verified symbolic executor for interval programs. *)
1385(* ===================================================================== *)
1387(* run the simulator until it is stuck (or out of fuel) *)
1388Fixpoint urun (p : positive) (c : cfg) : cfg * bool :=
1389 match p with
1390 | xH => match sstep c with Some (c', _) => (c', false) | None => (c, true) end
1391 | xO p' => let '(c1, s1) := urun p' c in if s1 then (c1, true) else urun p' c1
1392 | xI p' =>
1393 match sstep c with
1394 | Some (c0, _) => let '(c1, s1) := urun p' c0 in if s1 then (c1, true) else urun p' c1
1395 | None => (c, true)
1396 end
1397 end.
1399Lemma sstep_ev nu sg c c' b : sstep c = Some (c', b) -> ev_cfg nu sg c -->* ev_cfg nu sg c'.
1400Proof.
1401 intros E. pose proof (sstep_spec nu sg _ _ _ E) as H. destruct b; cbn in H; [apply progress_evstep|]; exact H.
1402Qed.
1404Lemma urun_spec p : forall c nu sg, ev_cfg nu sg c -->* ev_cfg nu sg (fst (urun p c)).
1405Proof.
1406 induction p as [p IH|p IH|]; intros c nu sg; cbn [urun].
1407 - destruct (sstep c) as [[c0 b]|] eqn:E; [|apply evstep_refl].
1408 pose proof (sstep_ev nu sg _ _ _ E) as H0.
1409 pose proof (IH c0 nu sg) as H1. destruct (urun p c0) as [c1 s1]. cbn [fst] in H1.
1410 destruct s1; cbn [fst].
1411 + eapply evstep_trans; eassumption.
1412 + eapply evstep_trans; [eassumption|]. eapply evstep_trans; [exact H1|]. apply IH.
1413 - pose proof (IH c nu sg) as H1. destruct (urun p c) as [c1 s1]. cbn [fst] in H1.
1414 destruct s1; cbn [fst]; [exact H1|]. eapply evstep_trans; [exact H1|]. apply IH.
1415 - destruct (sstep c) as [[c0 b]|] eqn:E; cbn [fst]; [|apply evstep_refl].
1416 exact (sstep_ev nu sg _ _ _ E).
1417Qed.
1419Definition tgtD (c : cfg) : option (list run) :=
1420 match c with
1421 | Lc D ([], TV O) (rr, T0) => Some rr
1422 | _ => None
1423 end.
1425Lemma tgtD_spec c rr : tgtD c = Some rr -> c = Lc D ([], TV 0) (rr, T0).
1426Proof.
1427 unfold tgtD. destruct c as [q l r|q [l t] [r t']]; [discriminate|].
1428 destruct q; try discriminate. destruct l; try discriminate.
1429 destruct t as [|[|k]]; try discriminate. destruct t'; try discriminate.
1430 intros H; inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
1431Qed.
1433Definition evR (nu : list N) (rr : list run) : side := ev_runs nu rr (const S0).
1435(* one episode of the right region, entered at phase p, the chain side abstract *)
1436Definition ep_run (p : bool) (rr : list run) : option (list run) :=
1437 tgtD (fst (urun 50000 (Rc (stp p) ([], TV 0) (rr, T0)))).
1439Lemma ep_run_spec p rr rr' : ep_run p rr = Some rr' -> forall nu, Ep p (evR nu rr) (evR nu rr').
1440Proof.
1441 unfold ep_run. intros H nu l.
1442 pose proof (urun_spec 50000 (Rc (stp p) ([], TV 0) (rr, T0)) nu (fun _ => l)) as U.
1443 destruct (urun 50000 (Rc (stp p) ([], TV 0) (rr, T0))) as [c s]. cbn [fst] in H, U.
1444 apply tgtD_spec in H. subst c. exact U.
1445Qed.
1447Fixpoint eps (ps : list bool) (rr : list run) : option (list run) :=
1448 match ps with
1449 | [] => Some rr
1450 | p :: ps' => match ep_run p rr with Some rr' => eps ps' rr' | None => None end
1451 end.
1453Lemma eps_spec ps : forall rr rr', eps ps rr = Some rr' -> forall nu, EpSeq ps (evR nu rr) (evR nu rr').
1454Proof.
1455 induction ps as [|p ps IH]; intros rr rr' H nu; cbn in H.
1456 - inversion H; reflexivity.
1457 - destruct (ep_run p rr) as [r1|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
1458 exists (evR nu r1). split; [apply (ep_run_spec _ _ _ E) | apply (IH _ _ H)].
1459Qed.
1461Lemma EpSeq_app a : forall b R R1 R2, EpSeq a R R1 -> EpSeq b R1 R2 -> EpSeq (a ++ b) R R2.
1462Proof.
1463 induction a as [|p a IH]; intros b R R1 R2 H1 H2; cbn in *.
1464 - subst. exact H2.
1465 - destruct H1 as [R3 [H3 H4]]. exists R3. split; [exact H3 | apply (IH _ _ _ _ H4 H2)].
1466Qed.
1468(* ---- linear-form algebra ---- *)
1470Definition evN (nu : list N) (a : lf) : N := (lc a + dot (lv a) nu)%N.
1472Lemma dot_zadd2 v : forall a b, dot v (zadd a b) = (dot v a + dot v b)%N.
1473Proof.
1474 induction v as [|x v IH]; intros [|y a] [|z b]; cbn; try lia.
1475 rewrite IH. lia.
1476Qed.
1478Definition vscale (k : N) (w : list N) : list N := map (N.mul k) w.
1480Lemma dot_vscale v : forall k w, dot v (vscale k w) = (k * dot v w)%N.
1481Proof. unfold vscale. induction v as [|x v IH]; intros k [|y w]; cbn; try lia. rewrite IH. lia. Qed.
1483Lemma ev_runs_dot nu nu' T X : (forall v, dot v nu = dot v nu') -> ev_runs nu T X = ev_runs nu' T X.
1484Proof.
1485 intros H. induction T as [|[b a] T IH]; cbn; [reflexivity|]. unfold ev. rewrite H, IH. reflexivity.
1486Qed.
1488Definition subst_lf (w : list N) (a : lf) : lf := LF (lc a + dot (lv a) w) (lv a).
1489Definition subst_runs (w : list N) (T : list run) : list run := map (fun r => (fst r, subst_lf w (snd r))) T.
1491Lemma ev_runs_subst nu w T X : ev_runs nu (subst_runs w T) X = ev_runs (zadd nu w) T X.
1492Proof.
1493 unfold subst_runs. induction T as [|[b a] T IH]; cbn; [reflexivity|]. rewrite IH. unfold ev, subst_lf. cbn.
1494 rewrite dot_zadd2. f_equal. f_equal. lia.
1495Qed.
1497Definition lf_scale (k : N) (a : lf) : lf := LF (k * lc a) (map (N.mul k) (lv a)).
1499Lemma dot_scale_l vs : forall k nu, dot (map (N.mul k) vs) nu = (k * dot vs nu)%N.
1500Proof. induction vs as [|x vs IH]; intros k [|y nu]; cbn; try lia. rewrite IH. lia. Qed.
1502Lemma evN_add nu a b : evN nu (lf_add a b) = (evN nu a + evN nu b)%N.
1503Proof. unfold evN, lf_add. cbn. rewrite dot_zadd. lia. Qed.
1505Lemma evN_scale nu k a : evN nu (lf_scale k a) = (k * evN nu a)%N.
1506Proof. unfold evN, lf_scale. cbn. rewrite dot_scale_l. lia. Qed.
1508Fixpoint comp_aux (vs : list N) (sg : list lf) : lf :=
1509 match vs, sg with
1510 | v :: vs', s :: sg' => lf_add (lf_scale v s) (comp_aux vs' sg')
1511 | _, _ => LF 0 []
1512 end.
1513Definition compose_lf (sg : list lf) (a : lf) : lf := lf_add (LF (lc a) []) (comp_aux (lv a) sg).
1514Definition comp_runs (sg : list lf) (T : list run) : list run := map (fun r => (fst r, compose_lf sg (snd r))) T.
1516Lemma evN_comp_aux nu vs : forall sg, evN nu (comp_aux vs sg) = dot vs (map (evN nu) sg).
1517Proof.
1518 induction vs as [|v vs IH]; intros [|s sg]; cbn [comp_aux map dot]; try reflexivity.
1519 rewrite evN_add, evN_scale, IH. lia.
1520Qed.
1522Lemma evN_compose nu sg a : evN nu (compose_lf sg a) = evN (map (evN nu) sg) a.
1523Proof. unfold compose_lf. rewrite evN_add, evN_comp_aux. unfold evN at 1 3. cbn. lia. Qed.
1525Lemma ev_runs_comp nu sg T X : ev_runs nu (comp_runs sg T) X = ev_runs (map (evN nu) sg) T X.
1526Proof.
1527 unfold comp_runs. induction T as [|[b a] T IH]; cbn; [reflexivity|]. rewrite IH. unfold ev.
1528 change (lc (compose_lf sg a) + dot (lv (compose_lf sg a)) nu)%N with (evN nu (compose_lf sg a)).
1529 rewrite evN_compose. reflexivity.
1530Qed.
1532(* ---- the 4-cycle jump (Lemma J) ---- *)
1534Lemma jump_lemma T p dec inc :
1535 (forall nu, EpSeq [p; p; p; p] (evR nu (subst_runs dec T)) (evR nu (subst_runs inc T))) ->
1536 forall k nu, EpSeq (repeat p (4 * k)) (evR (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) T)
1537 (evR (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat k) inc)) T).
1538Proof.
1539 intros Hc k. induction k as [|k IH]; intros nu.
1540 - cbn [repeat Nat.mul EpSeq]. unfold evR. apply ev_runs_dot. intros v.
1541 rewrite !dot_zadd2, !dot_vscale. lia.
1542 - replace (4 * S k) with (4 + 4 * k) by lia. rewrite repeat_add.
1543 apply (EpSeq_app _ _ _ (evR (zadd (zadd nu inc) (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) T)).
1544 + specialize (Hc (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec))). unfold evR in *.
1545 rewrite !ev_runs_subst in Hc.
1546 replace (ev_runs (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat (S k)) dec)) T (const S0))
1547 with (ev_runs (zadd (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) dec) T (const S0))
1548 by (apply ev_runs_dot; intros v; rewrite !dot_zadd2, !dot_vscale; lia).
1549 replace (ev_runs (zadd (zadd nu inc) (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) T (const S0))
1550 with (ev_runs (zadd (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) inc) T (const S0))
1551 by (apply ev_runs_dot; intros v; rewrite !dot_zadd2; lia).
1552 exact Hc.
1553 + specialize (IH (zadd nu inc)). unfold evR in *.
1554 replace (ev_runs (zadd nu (vscale (N.of_nat (S k)) inc)) T (const S0))
1555 with (ev_runs (zadd (zadd nu inc) (vscale (N.of_nat k) inc)) T (const S0))
1556 by (apply ev_runs_dot; intros v; rewrite !dot_zadd2, !dot_vscale; lia).
1557 replace (ev_runs (zadd (zadd nu inc) (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) T (const S0))
1558 with (ev_runs (zadd (zadd nu inc) (vscale (N.of_nat k) dec)) T (const S0)) by reflexivity.
1559 exact IH.
1560Qed.
1562(* ---- building a jump from the actual configuration ---- *)
1564Definition uvar (i : nat) (c : N) : lf := LF c (repeat 0%N i ++ [4%N]).
1566Fixpoint zsub (a b : list N) : list N :=
1567 match a, b with
1568 | x :: a', y :: b' => (x - y)%N :: zsub a' b'
1569 | _, [] => a
1570 | [], _ => []
1571 end.
1573Fixpoint mk_jump (i : nat) (rr rr4 : list run) (c : lf) : option (list run * list N * list N * list lf) :=
1574 match rr, rr4 with
1575 | [], [] => Some ([], [], [], [])
1576 | (b, a) :: rr', (b4, a4) :: rr4' =>
1577 if negb (seqb b b4) then None else
1578 if negb (listN_eqb (strip0 (lv a)) (strip0 (lv a4))) then None else
1579 match mk_jump (S i) rr' rr4' c with
1580 | None => None
1581 | Some (T, dec, inc, sg) =>
1582 let d := (Z.of_N (lc a4) - Z.of_N (lc a))%Z in
1583 if negb (Z.eqb (Z.modulo d 4) 0) then None else
1584 let q := Z.div d 4 in
1585 if andb (allz (lv a)) (Z.eqb q 0) then
1586 Some ((b, a) :: T, 0%N :: dec, 0%N :: inc, LF 0 [] :: sg)
1587 else if Z.ltb q 0 then
1588 let dn := Z.to_N (- q) in
1589 let M := (lc a - 4 * dn * lc c)%N in
1590 let s := LF 0 (map (fun x => x / 4)%N (zsub (lv a) (map (N.mul (4 * dn)) (lv c)))) in
1591 Some ((b, uvar i M) :: T, dn :: dec, 0%N :: inc, s :: sg)
1592 else
1593 let s := LF 0 (map (fun x => x / 4)%N (lv a)) in
1594 Some ((b, uvar i (lc a)) :: T, 0%N :: dec, Z.to_N q :: inc, s :: sg)
1595 end
1596 | _, _ => None
1597 end.
1599Fixpoint mapadd (c : lf) (sg : list lf) (w : list N) : list lf :=
1600 match sg, w with
1601 | s :: sg', x :: w' => lf_add s (lf_scale x c) :: mapadd c sg' w'
1602 | _, _ => []
1603 end.
1605Lemma mapadd_ev nu c sg : forall w, length sg = length w ->
1606 map (evN nu) (mapadd c sg w) = zadd (map (evN nu) sg) (vscale (evN nu c) w).
1607Proof.
1608 induction sg as [|s sg IH]; intros [|x w] Hl; cbn in Hl; try discriminate; [reflexivity|].
1609 cbn [mapadd map vscale zadd]. injection Hl as Hl. rewrite (IH w Hl). unfold vscale.
1610 f_equal. rewrite evN_add, evN_scale. lia.
1611Qed.
1613Definition cyc4 (p : bool) : list bool := [p; p; p; p].
1615Definition jump_run (p : bool) (c : lf) (rr : list run) : option (list run) :=
1616 match eps (cyc4 p) rr with
1617 | None => None
1618 | Some rr4 =>
1619 match mk_jump 0 rr rr4 c with
1620 | None => None
1621 | Some (T, dec, inc, sg) =>
1622 if andb (Nat.eqb (length sg) (length dec)) (Nat.eqb (length sg) (length inc)) then
1623 match eps (cyc4 p) (subst_runs dec T) with
1624 | None => None
1625 | Some X =>
1626 if andb (runs_eqb X (subst_runs inc T)) (runs_eqb rr (comp_runs (mapadd c sg dec) T))
1627 then Some (comp_runs (mapadd c sg inc) T) else None
1628 end
1629 else None
1630 end
1631 end.
1633Lemma jump_run_spec p c rr rr' : jump_run p c rr = Some rr' ->
1634 forall nu, EpSeq (repeat p (4 * ev nu c)) (evR nu rr) (evR nu rr').
1635Proof.
1636 unfold jump_run. intros H nu.
1637 destruct (eps (cyc4 p) rr) as [rr4|]; [|discriminate].
1638 destruct (mk_jump 0 rr rr4 c) as [[[[T dec] inc] sg]|]; [|discriminate].
1639 destruct (andb (Nat.eqb (length sg) (length dec)) (Nat.eqb (length sg) (length inc))) eqn:El; [|discriminate].
1640 apply andb_prop in El as [El1 El2]. apply Nat.eqb_eq in El1, El2.
1641 destruct (eps (cyc4 p) (subst_runs dec T)) as [X|] eqn:EX; [|discriminate].
1642 destruct (andb (runs_eqb X (subst_runs inc T)) (runs_eqb rr (comp_runs (mapadd c sg dec) T))) eqn:Ec;
1643 [|discriminate].
1644 apply andb_prop in Ec as [Ec1 Ec2]. inversion H; subst rr'; clear H.
1645 assert (Hc : forall nu', EpSeq [p; p; p; p] (evR nu' (subst_runs dec T)) (evR nu' (subst_runs inc T))).
1646 { intros nu'. pose proof (eps_spec _ _ _ EX nu') as HX. unfold evR in *.
1647 rewrite <-(runs_eqb_ev nu' _ _ (const S0) Ec1). exact HX. }
1648 pose proof (jump_lemma T p dec inc Hc (ev nu c) (map (evN nu) sg)) as J.
1649 unfold ev in J at 2 3. rewrite N2Nat.id in J.
1650 unfold evR in *. rewrite (runs_eqb_ev nu _ _ (const S0) Ec2), !ev_runs_comp, !mapadd_ev by assumption.
1651 exact J.
1652Qed.
1654(* ---- programs: single episodes and jumps ---- *)
1656Inductive instr := ISingle (p : bool) | IJump (p : bool) (c : lf).
1658Definition seg : Type := (bool * lf)%type.
1660Fixpoint segs_ev (nu : list N) (ss : list seg) : list bool :=
1661 match ss with [] => [] | (p, n) :: ss' => repeat p (ev nu n) ++ segs_ev nu ss' end.
1663Fixpoint exec (prog : list instr) (rr : list run) : option (list run * list seg) :=
1664 match prog with
1665 | [] => Some (rr, [])
1666 | ISingle p :: prog' =>
1667 match ep_run p rr with
1668 | Some rr1 => match exec prog' rr1 with Some (rr2, ss) => Some (rr2, (p, cn 1) :: ss) | None => None end
1669 | None => None
1670 end
1671 | IJump p c :: prog' =>
1672 match jump_run p c rr with
1673 | Some rr1 => match exec prog' rr1 with Some (rr2, ss) => Some (rr2, (p, lf_scale 4 c) :: ss) | None => None end
1674 | None => None
1675 end
1676 end.
1678Lemma ev_scale4 nu c : ev nu (lf_scale 4 c) = 4 * ev nu c.
1679Proof. unfold ev. change (lc (lf_scale 4 c) + dot (lv (lf_scale 4 c)) nu)%N with (evN nu (lf_scale 4 c)).
1680 rewrite evN_scale. unfold evN. lia. Qed.
1682Lemma exec_spec prog : forall rr rr' ss, exec prog rr = Some (rr', ss) ->
1683 forall nu, EpSeq (segs_ev nu ss) (evR nu rr) (evR nu rr').
1684Proof.
1685 induction prog as [|[p|p c] prog IH]; intros rr rr' ss H nu; cbn [exec] in H.
1686 - inversion H; subst. reflexivity.
1687 - destruct (ep_run p rr) as [rr1|] eqn:E1; [|discriminate].
1688 destruct (exec prog rr1) as [[rr2 ss2]|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate].
1689 inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [segs_ev].
1690 replace (ev nu (cn 1)) with 1 by reflexivity. cbn [repeat app].
1691 exists (evR nu rr1). split; [apply (ep_run_spec _ _ _ E1) | apply (IH _ _ _ E2)].
1692 - destruct (jump_run p c rr) as [rr1|] eqn:E1; [|discriminate].
1693 destruct (exec prog rr1) as [[rr2 ss2]|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate].
1694 inversion H; subst; clear H. cbn [segs_ev]. rewrite ev_scale4.
1695 apply (EpSeq_app _ _ _ (evR nu rr1)); [apply (jump_run_spec _ _ _ _ E1) | apply (IH _ _ _ E2)].
1696Qed.
1698(* the phase sequence of a program: all c_K + 2 episodes first, then all c_K episodes *)
1699Fixpoint sum_ph (p : bool) (ss : list seg) : lf :=
1700 match ss with
1701 | [] => LF 0 []
1702 | (q, n) :: ss' => if Bool.eqb p q then lf_add n (sum_ph p ss') else sum_ph p ss'
1703 end.
1704Fixpoint split_ok (seen_false : bool) (ss : list seg) : bool :=
1705 match ss with
1706 | [] => true
1707 | (true, _) :: ss' => andb (negb seen_false) (split_ok false ss')
1708 | (false, _) :: ss' => split_ok true ss'
1709 end.
1711Lemma ev_lf_add nu a b : ev nu (lf_add a b) = ev nu a + ev nu b.
1712Proof. apply ev_add. Qed.
1714Lemma split_false ss nu : split_ok true ss = true -> segs_ev nu ss = repeat false (ev nu (sum_ph false ss)).
1715Proof.
1716 induction ss as [|[q n] ss IH]; intros H; [reflexivity|].
1717 destruct q; cbn in H; [discriminate|]. cbn [segs_ev sum_ph Bool.eqb]. rewrite ev_lf_add, repeat_add, IH by exact H.
1718 reflexivity.
1719Qed.
1721Lemma sum_false_true ss : split_ok true ss = true -> sum_ph true ss = LF 0 [] \/ True.
1722Proof. auto. Qed.
1724Lemma split_spec ss nu : split_ok false ss = true ->
1725 segs_ev nu ss = repeat true (ev nu (sum_ph true ss)) ++ repeat false (ev nu (sum_ph false ss)).
1726Proof.
1727 induction ss as [|[q n] ss IH]; intros H; [reflexivity|].
1728 destruct q.
1729 - cbn in H. cbn [segs_ev sum_ph Bool.eqb]. rewrite ev_lf_add, repeat_add, IH by exact H. rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
1730 - cbn in H. cbn [segs_ev sum_ph Bool.eqb]. rewrite split_false by exact H.
1731 assert (Et : ev nu (sum_ph true ((false, n) :: ss)) = 0).
1732 { clear IH. cbn [sum_ph Bool.eqb]. revert H. induction ss as [|[q m] ss IH2]; intros H; [reflexivity|].
1733 destruct q; cbn in H; [discriminate|]. cbn [sum_ph Bool.eqb]. apply IH2, H. }
1734 cbn [sum_ph Bool.eqb] in Et. rewrite Et. cbn [repeat app]. rewrite ev_lf_add, repeat_add. reflexivity.
1735Qed.
1737Definition prog_check (prog : list instr) (rs re : list run) (T F : lf) : bool :=
1738 match exec prog rs with
1739 | Some (re', ss) =>
1740 andb (andb (runs_eqb re' re) (split_ok false ss)) (andb (lf_eqb (sum_ph true ss) T) (lf_eqb (sum_ph false ss) F))
1741 | None => false
1742 end.
1744Lemma prog_check_spec prog rs re T F : prog_check prog rs re T F = true ->
1745 forall nu, EpSeq (repeat true (ev nu T) ++ repeat false (ev nu F)) (evR nu rs) (evR nu re).
1746Proof.
1747 unfold prog_check. intros H nu.
1748 destruct (exec prog rs) as [[re' ss]|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
1749 apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2]. apply andb_prop in H1 as [H1 H3]. apply andb_prop in H2 as [H2 H4].
1750 pose proof (exec_spec _ _ _ _ E nu) as HE. rewrite (split_spec _ _ H3) in HE.
1751 rewrite (lf_eqb_ev nu _ _ H2), (lf_eqb_ev nu _ _ H4) in HE.
1752 unfold evR in *. rewrite <-(runs_eqb_ev nu _ _ (const S0) H1). exact HE.
1753Qed.

1791(* ===================================================================== *)
1792(* The regrouping after the record visit (write-up 6.2): the chain in D2 *)
1793(* is the same tape as a chain in U0 grouped one defect later. *)
1794(* ===================================================================== *)
1796Definition rtop (qs : list (list N)) (z : N) : N :=
1797 match qs with [] => z | q :: _ => nth 0 q 0%N end.
1799Fixpoint rshift (qs : list (list N)) (z : N) : list (list N) :=
1800 match qs with
1801 | [] => []
1802 | q :: qs' => [nth 1 q 0; nth 2 q 0; nth 3 q 0; rtop qs' z]%N :: rshift qs' z
1803 end.
1805Lemma shift_len qs z : length (rshift qs z) = length qs.
1806Proof. induction qs; cbn; congruence. Qed.
1808Lemma dot4 (a b c d : N) q :
1809 dot [a; b; c; d] q = (a * nth 0 q 0 + b * nth 1 q 0 + c * nth 2 q 0 + d * nth 3 q 0)%N.
1810Proof. destruct q as [|x0 [|x1 [|x2 [|x3 q]]]]; cbn; lia. Qed.
1812Lemma alt_split b m k : Nat.eqb (m mod 2) 0 = true -> alt b (m + k) = alt b m ++ alt b k.
1813Proof.
1814 intros H. rewrite alt_add. unfold afterb_nat. rewrite H. reflexivity.
1815Qed.
1817Lemma ev_q nu c a : ev nu (LF c a) = N.to_nat (c + dot a nu).
1818Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
1820Lemma regroup qs : forall z X X',
1821 X = alt S0 1 *> (alt S0 (2 + 4 * N.to_nat z) *> X') ->
1822 chs (repeat D2 (length qs)) qs X =
1823 alt S0 1 *> (alt S0 (2 + 4 * N.to_nat (rtop qs z)) *> chs (repeat U0 (length qs)) (rshift qs z) X').
1824Proof.
1825 induction qs as [|q qs IH]; intros z X X' HX; [exact HX|].
1826 cbn [length repeat chs rshift rtop]. rewrite (IH z X X' HX).
1827 set (Y := chs (repeat U0 (length qs)) (rshift qs z) X').
1828 change (blk D2) with [(S0, cn 1); (S0, vt 5); (S0, vs 4); (S1, va 4); (S0, vl 0)]%N.
1829 change (blk U0) with [(S0, cn 3); (S0, vt 4); (S1, vs 4); (S0, va 1); (S0, vl 2)]%N.
1830 cbn [ev_runs]. unfold ev, vt, vs, va, vl, cn. cbn [lc lv]. rewrite !dot4. cbn [nth dot].
1831 set (xt := nth 0 q 0%N). set (xs := nth 1 q 0%N). set (xa := nth 2 q 0%N). set (xI := nth 3 q 0%N).
1832 set (tz := rtop qs z).
1833 assert (E1 : alt S0 (N.to_nat (5 + (4 * xt + 0 * xs + 0 * xa + 0 * xI))) = alt S0 (2 + 4 * N.to_nat xt) ++ alt S0 3).
1834 { replace (N.to_nat (5 + (4 * xt + 0 * xs + 0 * xa + 0 * xI))) with ((2 + 4 * N.to_nat xt) + 3) by lia.
1835 apply alt_split. apply Nat.eqb_eq. replace (2 + 4 * N.to_nat xt) with (2 + N.to_nat xt * 2 * 2) by lia.
1836 rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. }
1837 assert (E2 : alt S0 (N.to_nat (1 + (0 * xs + 0 * xa + 4 * xI + 0 * tz))) = alt S0 (N.to_nat (0 + (0 * xt + 0 * xs + 0 * xa + 4 * xI))) ++ alt S0 1).
1838 { replace (N.to_nat (1 + (0 * xs + 0 * xa + 4 * xI + 0 * tz))) with (N.to_nat (0 + (0 * xt + 0 * xs + 0 * xa + 4 * xI)) + 1) by lia.
1839 apply alt_split. apply Nat.eqb_eq. replace (N.to_nat (0 + (0 * xt + 0 * xs + 0 * xa + 4 * xI))) with (0 + N.to_nat xI * 2 * 2) by lia.
1840 rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. }
1841 rewrite E1, E2, !Str_app_assoc. cbn [alt Str_app app].
1842 replace (N.to_nat (2 + (0 * xs + 0 * xa + 0 * xI + 4 * tz))) with (2 + 4 * N.to_nat tz) by lia.
1843 replace (N.to_nat (4 + (4 * xs + 0 * xa + 0 * xI + 0 * tz))) with (N.to_nat (4 + (0 * xt + 4 * xs + 0 * xa + 0 * xI))) by lia.
1844 replace (N.to_nat (4 + (0 * xs + 4 * xa + 0 * xI + 0 * tz))) with (N.to_nat (4 + (0 * xt + 0 * xs + 4 * xa + 0 * xI))) by lia.
1845 reflexivity.
1846Qed.

1849Lemma regroup_b1 : b1s PD2 (LWs 81) = alt S0 1 *> (alt S0 (2 + 4 * N.to_nat 0) *> b1s P0 (LWs 0)).
1850Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

1856Lemma drop_step L Re Rs nu X' :
1857 reach 100000 (Rc B (L, TV 0) (Re, T0)) (Lc D ([], TV 0) (Rs, T0)) = true ->
1858 ev_runs nu L X' {{B}}> evR nu Re -->+ X' <{{D}} evR nu Rs.
1859Proof. intros H. exact (reach_spec _ _ _ H nu (fun _ => X')). Qed.
1861Definition W5t (t : N) : N := (18701 + 149688 * t)%N.
1862Definition W5s (t : N) : N := (6227 + 49896 * t)%N.
1863Definition W5a (t : N) : N := (2069 + 16632 * t)%N.
1865Lemma rec_r5_ok : reach 100000 (Rc B ([(S0, cn 1); (S0, tl1 74806 598752)], TV 0) (Re_r5, T0)) (Lc D ([], TV 0) (Rs_r0, T0)) = true.
1866Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
1868Lemma step_r5 t f1 deep :
1869 chs (repeat D2 (S (length deep))) ([W5t t; W5s t; W5a t; f1] :: deep) (b1s PD2 (LWs 81)) {{B}}> evR [t] Re_r5 -->+
1870 Gc (repeat U0 (S (length deep)), P0, 0) ([W5s t; W5a t; f1; rtop deep 0%N] :: rshift deep 0%N) (evR [t] Rs_r0).
1871Proof.
1872 pose proof (regroup ([W5t t; W5s t; W5a t; f1] :: deep) 0%N _ (b1s P0 (LWs 0)) regroup_b1) as E.
1873 cbn [length] in E. rewrite E. clear E. cbn [rtop rshift nth Gc].
1874 set (X' := chs (repeat U0 (S (length deep))) ([W5s t; W5a t; f1; rtop deep 0%N] :: rshift deep 0%N) (b1s P0 (LWs 0))).
1875 replace (2 + 4 * N.to_nat (W5t t)) with (ev [t] (tl1 74806 598752)) by (unfold ev, W5t, tl1; cbn [lc lv dot]; lia).
1876 change (alt S0 1 *> (alt S0 (ev [t] (tl1 74806 598752)) *> X')) with (ev_runs [t] [(S0, cn 1); (S0, tl1 74806 598752)] X').
1877 apply drop_step, rec_r5_ok.
1878Qed.
1880Lemma pow_K0 k0 e : 2 <= e -> 3 ^ (k0 + 2 * e) = 3 ^ (k0 + 4) * 9 ^ (e - 2).
1881Proof.
1882 intros He. replace (k0 + 2 * e) with ((k0 + 4) + 2 * (e - 2)) by lia.
1883 rewrite Nat.pow_add_r, Nat.pow_mul_r. reflexivity.
1884Qed.
1886(* one record interval of class r5 *)
1887Lemma S_r5 e t f1 deep : 2 <= e -> 1 + 8 * N.to_nat t = 9 ^ (e - 2) -> length deep = 1 + 2 * e ->
1888 Gc (repeat U0 (S (length deep)), P0, 0) ([W5t t; W5s t; W5a t; f1] :: deep) (evR [t] Rs_r5) -->+
1889 Gc (repeat U0 (S (length deep)), P0, 0) ([W5s t; W5a t; f1; rtop deep 0%N] :: rshift deep 0%N) (evR [t] Rs_r0).
1890Proof.
1891 intros He Ht Hl.
1892 eapply evstep_progress_trans; [apply interval_tm; [lia | reflexivity |]|].
1893 - intros T ET. pose proof (prog_check_spec _ _ _ _ _ int_r5 [t]) as HP.
1894 assert (E3 : 3 ^ S (S (S (length deep))) = 81 * 81 * (1 + 8 * N.to_nat t)).
1895 { rewrite Ht, Hl. replace (S (S (S (1 + 2 * e)))) with (4 + 2 * e) by lia.
1896 rewrite pow_K0 by exact He. reflexivity. }
1897 assert (E2 : 3 ^ S (S (length deep)) = 27 * 81 * (1 + 8 * N.to_nat t)).
1898 { rewrite Ht, Hl. replace (S (S (1 + 2 * e))) with (3 + 2 * e) by lia.
1899 rewrite pow_K0 by exact He. reflexivity. }
1900 rewrite E3 in ET. rewrite E2.
1901 replace T with (ev [t] (tl1 3278 26244)) by (unfold ev, tl1; cbn [lc lv dot]; lia).
1902 replace (81 * (27 * 81 * (1 + 8 * N.to_nat t)) - 1 - ev [t] (tl1 3278 26244)) with (ev [t] (tl1 173868 1390932))
1903 by (unfold ev, tl1; cbn [lc lv dot]; lia).
1904 exact HP.
1905 - eapply progress_trans; [apply record_visit; reflexivity|].
1906 apply step_r5.
1907Qed.
1909Definition wv (c a t : N) : N := (c + a * t)%N.
1911Lemma evN_tl1 c a t : evN [t] (tl1 c a) = wv c a t.
1912Proof. unfold evN, tl1, wv. cbn [lc lv dot]. lia. Qed.
1914Lemma take_step L first4 Re' Rs nu sg X' :
1915 reach 100000 (Rc B (L, TV 0) (first4, TV 1)) (Rc A (comp_runs sg (blk U0), TV 0) ([], TV 1)) = true ->
1916 ep_run true Re' = Some Rs ->
1917 ev_runs nu L X' {{B}}> ev_runs nu first4 (evR nu Re') -->+
1918 ev_runs (map (evN nu) sg) (blk U0) X' <{{D}} evR nu Rs.
1919Proof.
1920 intros H1 H2. eapply progress_evstep_trans.
1921 - exact (reach_spec _ _ _ H1 nu (sg2 X' (evR nu Re'))).
1922 - change (ev_runs nu (comp_runs sg (blk U0)) X' {{A}}> evR nu Re' -->*
1923 ev_runs (map (evN nu) sg) (blk U0) X' <{{D}} evR nu Rs).
1924 rewrite ev_runs_comp. apply (ep_run_spec _ _ _ H2 nu).
1925Qed.
1927Lemma split4 nu r1 r2 r3 b c v rest X :
1928 ev_runs nu (r1 :: r2 :: r3 :: (b, LF (3 + c) v) :: rest) X =
1929 ev_runs nu [r1; r2; r3; (b, cn 3)] (ev_runs nu ((sneg b, LF c v) :: rest) X).
1930Proof.
1931 destruct r1 as [b1 n1], r2 as [b2 n2], r3 as [b3 n3]. cbn [ev_runs].
1932 assert (E : alt b (ev nu (LF (3 + c) v)) = alt b 3 ++ alt (sneg b) (ev nu (LF c v))).
1933 { unfold ev. cbn [lc lv].
1934 replace (N.to_nat (3 + c + dot v nu)) with (3 + N.to_nat (c + dot v nu)) by lia.
1935 rewrite alt_add. reflexivity. }
1936 rewrite E, Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
1937Qed.

2415(* ===================================================================== *)
2416(* The invariant at the start of every record interval, and its closure. *)
2417(* ===================================================================== *)
2419Inductive cls := C5 | C0 | C1 | C2 | C3 | C4.
2421Definition Rs (r : cls) : list run :=
2422 match r with C5 => Rs_r5 | C0 => Rs_r0 | C1 => Rs_r1 | C2 => Rs_r2 | C3 => Rs_r3 | C4 => Rs_r4 end.
2424Definition ist : Type := (cls * nat * N * list (list N))%type.
2426Definition cfgI (s : ist) : Q * tape :=
2427 let '(r, e, t, nus) := s in Gc (repeat U0 (length nus), P0, 0) nus (evR [t] (Rs r)).
2429Definition win (r : cls) (e : nat) (t : N) (nus : list (list N)) : Prop :=
2430 match r with
2431 | C5 => exists f1 deep, nus = [W5t t; W5s t; W5a t; f1] :: deep /\ length deep = 1 + 2 * e
2432 | C0 => exists f1 f2 deep, nus = [W0t t; W0s t; f1; f2] :: deep /\ length deep = 1 + 2 * e

submission/proof.md line 161: 2.2 The eight rules

At a defect e the head sees d = (e - φ) mod 4. Here ^ is symmetric difference.

head d = 0 d = 1 d = 2 d = 3
moving left pass, φ+1 turn right; D ^= {e-1, e} turn right; D ^= {e-1, e} pass, φ-1
moving right turn left; D ^= {e, e+1} wiggle; D ^= {e, e+2}, then pass, φ+1 pass, φ-1 pass, φ+1

Turns keep φ. A turn moves the defect by one cell, a wiggle by two.

Each rule is a run of two to five transitions at the defect. The state on the near cell follows from the phase. The far cell holds the same symbol as the near one, which breaks the cycle:

head d near cell transitions what breaks the cycle
left 0 C0 on e+1 C0, D0 nothing: D0 is in the left cycle at the new phase
left 1 E1 on e+1 E1, C1 C1 = 0RA turns the head right
left 2 D0 on e+1 D0, E0 E0 = 1RB turns the head right
left 3 D1 on e+1 D1, D1 nothing
right 0 B0 on e B0, C0 C0 = 1LD turns the head left
right 1 C1 on e C1, A1, F0, A0, B1 A1 = 0RF; F reads cell e+2
right 2 A0 on e A0, B0 nothing
right 3 B1 on e B1, B1 nothing

Halting. The machine halts only through F reading 1, and F is entered only by A1, which occurs only in the wiggle. There F reads cell e+2, and cell e+2 holds 1 exactly when e+1 is also a defect.

So the machine halts exactly when the head moves right, sees d = 1, and e+1 is also a defect.

Collisions. A turn or wiggle whose toggled edge is already a defect makes two defects cancel. This does happen, inside some right-region episodes (4.3 works out an example). The rules above already cover it, since a toggle is a symmetric difference.

So the proof does not assume that defects never cancel. Only the halting case has to be ruled out.
